title: How fold mountains are pushed up
group: HOWN — How and Why in Nature
examples: Why are the Himalayas so high?

explain.say: The highest mountains on Earth are fold mountains. They form where two plates carrying continents push into each other, like two cars in a very slow crash.

draw.text: How fold mountains are pushed up

explain.say: Continental rock is too light to sink into the mantle, so when the plates collide the rock has nowhere to go but up. Layers bend into folds, like a rug pushed against a wall.
The squeezed and stacked rock rises higher and higher. The Himalayas began rising about 50 million years ago, when India crashed into Asia, and they are still growing today.
Gravity and erosion fight back, pulling rock down and wearing peaks away. A mountain's height is a balance between the push from below and the wearing away from above.

faq.a: When two continental plates collide, the rock between them is squeezed, bent into folds and pushed upward. The Himalayas, the Alps and the Andes all formed from plates pushing together.

faq.q: Why are the Himalayas so high?
faq.a: India is still pushing into Asia at about 4 to 5 centimetres a year, and the thick crust keeps getting squeezed upward. Mount Everest, at 8,849 metres, is the highest mountain above sea level.
Some are. The Himalayas rise by a few millimetres each year, though erosion also wears them down. Old mountains, like the Appalachians, have stopped growing and are slowly being worn away.

faq.q: Why are there sea fossils on top of Mount Everest?
faq.a: The rock at the top of Everest is limestone that formed on an ancient sea floor. When India and Asia collided, that sea floor was pushed up nearly 9 kilometres.
asks: How did seashells get on mountains?

faq.q: What are the other ways mountains form?
faq.a: Besides folding, mountains form from volcanoes piling up lava, and from blocks of crust lifted up along faults, called block mountains.

facts: Mount Everest is 8,849 metres above sea level, measured in 2020.
The Indian plate began colliding with Asia about 50 million years ago.
Marine fossils are found in limestone near the summit of Mount Everest.

quiz.why: Limestone formed on an ancient sea floor was folded and lifted when India crashed into Asia.

wrong.1: The fossils are inside the rock itself, so birds could not have dropped them.
